assessment: This study provides convincing evidence that homologous recombination can occur in telophase-arrested cells, independently of cohesin subunits Smc 1-3. These findings are valuable as they point to investigate the role of cohesins re-association with chromatin in the allelic inter-sister repair by homologous recombination.
